name: reverse_larks_head_knot
title: Reverse lark's head knot
about: The lark's head knot seen from its back: the bar lies behind the two legs, which hang down in front of it. Shown loose, tied with one end.

steps.caption: Bring the working cord up behind the holding cord, over it, and back down in front of it.
Take it across to the right, behind its own first leg: this is the bar.
Take it up in front of the holding cord, over it and down behind, then over the bar. Pull both legs down: the bar tightens behind them.
